subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical current-main live reproduction request for the four-agent Telegram/provider timeout pattern, or should the remaining work be split by owner boundary now that terminal-abort fallback mitigations have merged?
rationale: The observable failure spans channel concurrency, provider transport, fallback policy, run budgeting, and launch/runtime defaults; automation cannot safely choose the permanent owner boundary without a current-main trace or maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Run Current-Main Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a four-agent Telegram trace on current main before selecting a code or config change.

options.title: Split By Owner Boundary
options.body: Use this issue as the symptom record and open narrower follow-ups once maintainers choose Telegram concurrency, provider transport, or fallback/run-budget ownership.

options.title: Close Only With Positive Mitigation Proof
options.body: Close after a current-main run shows the original simultaneous timeout pattern no longer occurs with the merged fallback mitigations.

recommendation.title: Run Current-Main Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a four-agent Telegram trace on current main before selecting a code or config change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest visible history across fallback, provider transport, and Telegram polling surfaces involved in the boundary choice.
